rules: FF high-impact AUD / NZD releases 21:45-07:00 UTC, NAS100 quoting at the release minute. Range = NAS100 bid high / low of the release minute .. release + 2 incl. the pre-release close. At release + 3 min: buy stop at range high + 0.05 ATR, sell stop at range low - 0.05 ATR (OCO), valid 60 min. Stop 0.5 x ATR(24 x H1) from the fill, target 3 R, exit 6 h after the fill, Friday 20:00 UTC cap, one position, 10 % risk.
